stem:
Indira studies four pure samples: distilled water, made of identical molecules each containing hydrogen and oxygen; oxygen gas, made of identical molecules each containing only oxygen; carbon dioxide gas, made of identical molecules each containing carbon and oxygen; and sugar crystals, made of molecules containing carbon, hydrogen and oxygen. An element is a pure substance made of only one kind of identical particle.

Which sample should she classify as an element?

options.text: Distilled water, made of identical molecules each containing hydrogen and oxygen.
Oxygen gas, made of identical molecules each containing only oxygen.
Carbon dioxide gas, made of identical molecules each containing carbon and oxygen.
Sugar crystals, made of molecules containing carbon, hydrogen and oxygen.

teacher.key_rationale: Oxygen gas has only one kind of particle (oxygen), so it is an element. Water, carbon dioxide, and sugar each contain more than one kind of atom.
